Evidence: Customers in the 0-6 month group have a 52.94% churn rate, compared with 19.51% for customers with more than six months.
Interpretation: The first six months are an important customer lifecycle segment.
Contract type is strongly associated with observed churn.
Caution: The analysis does not establish a causal effect of contract type.

Evidence: Fiber optic churn = 41.89%, DSL = 18.96%, no internet = 7.40%.
Interpretation: Internet service type separates customer groups with materially different observed churn rates.

Evidence: Electronic-check churn = 45.29%, automatic bank transfer = 16.71%, automatic credit card = 15.24%.
Interpretation: Payment method is a strong descriptive separator in this dataset.
